reviewSamples.text: WOW!!! I ordered Donnie’s for my daughter’s college graduation dinner at home and we were all floored with the flavors and quality of the food we received. Donnie is my new go-to for any events and I will recommend him to everyone. He’s friendly, has fair pricing and a pleasure to deal with. Thank you Donnie!!
